subject: NexGen Financial POC: scope, milestones, and exec readout scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@nexgenfin.com>, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-06-10 09:15 -0400
Subject: Post-call recap: discovery + proposed POC scope

Alex — thanks again for taking time this morning. Short recap from our discovery call and a proposed next-step plan so we’re all aligned. Please reply with corrections or priorities.

Key takeaways from today’s call:
- Primary use case: extract structured transaction metadata and reconcile disputed charges across heterogeneous logs (banking + internal transaction systems).
- Primary success metric: 95% precision on dispute classification for the top 3 dispute types (duplication, chargeback, merchant error) measured over the POC validation set.
- Latency requirement: 95th percentile token latency under 350ms for real-time API surface, batch scoring can be relaxed.
- Data constraints: customer will provide anonymized sample data (PII removed) and a test S3 bucket for batch runs.

Proposed 4-week POC (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week): ingest sample dataset + config baseline
2) Week 1: run baseline model and collect metrics (precision/recall by dispute type)
3) Week 2: iterate on prompts/thresholds and run targeted rerank experiments
4) Week 3: production-like batch run and rollback/observability check
5) Week 4: readout and decision (go/no-go) — exec review + contract motion if green

Owners (initial):
- Redwood technical lead: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwoodinference.com) — POC infra & baseline runs
- Redwood product: Olga Petrov (olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com) — evaluation plan & metrics
- NexGen: Alex Turner — sample data + validation reviewers

Deliverables we’ll prepare:
- Shared evaluation spreadsheet with per-case labels and scoring (I’ll draft)
- Mutual action plan with milestones and signoffs
- Short runbook for onboarding the S3 bucket and credentials

Attachments: I’ll send an initial success-criteria spreadsheet after this note.

Next steps: Alex — can you confirm
1) availability of the anonymized sample dataset this week?
2) primary exec(s) that should attend the final readout (title preferred)?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@nexgenfin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-06-11 11:08 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: discovery + proposed POC scope

Thanks, Marissa — solid summary. A few clarifications and we attached the initial labels spreadsheet for your baseline.

Quick clarifications:
- Data: we can provide a 10k-row anonymized extract by EOD Thursday (2028-06-13). It’s coming from our dispute_data table with PII columns redacted.
- Validation reviewers: please plan for our Head of Ops (Lina Park) to join the final readout; she’s the decision owner on acceptance criteria. CTO (Marcus Reed) will join if the metrics look promising.
- Procurement: I’ve copied procurement@nexgenfin.com for contract/PO coordination — they’ll request an SOW and an estimate if we move to reserved capacity.

Attached: NexGen_POC_success_criteria.xlsx — includes a suggested labeling schema and a small seed set we used internally.

Alex Turner
Senior Product Manager — Transaction Services
NexGen Financial
alex.turner@nexgenfin.com | +1 (212) 555-0142

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: discovery + proposed POC scope

Following up with a couple of infra/measurement questions so we can lock owners and timelines:

1) Data access — Alex, is the sample S3 bucket going to be cross-account with pre-signed URLs or will you provide temporary IAM creds? If pre-signed, what is the TTL?
2) Validation set labeling — Olga, can you confirm the minimal label set you need to compute the 95% precision metric (i.e., which columns and canonical labels)?
3) Exec readout — Marissa, are there preferred slots the NexGen execs gave you? We want to reserve a 45-minute slot (30min readout + 15min decision Q&A).

Tentative timeline impact: if sample data lands by 2028-06-13 (EOD), we can complete baseline and first iteration by 2028-07-08 and propose an exec readout window the week of 2028-07-10. If data slips a week, shift the readout accordingly.

Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@nexgenfin.com>, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com, procurement@nexgenfin.com
Date: 2028-06-13 10:45 -0400
Subject: Mutual action plan + owners (draft) — NexGen POC

Team — I drafted a compact mutual action plan to keep cadence tight. See attached PDF (Mutual_Action_Plan_NexGen_v1.pdf). Highlights below: 

Mutual Action Plan (summary)
- Onboard: 2028-06-13 — sample data transfer + creds verification (owner: NexGen / Alex)
- Baseline run: 2028-06-14 to 2028-06-21 (owner: Ben) — produce baseline metrics and error slices
- Iteration sprint: 2028-06-22 to 2028-07-05 (owner: Ben/Olga) — prompt/rerank experiments, threshold tuning
- Production-like batch: 2028-07-06 to 2028-07-08 (owner: Ben) — run full validation set and produce final scores
- Readout window: propose week of 2028-07-10 (owner: Marissa) — 45-minute exec review with decision (go/no-go)

Acceptance gating (draft):
- Primary gate: >=95% precision on top-3 dispute types on the validation set
- Secondary gate: latency SLO verification (95th <= 350ms) for API calls under test load
- Ops gate: mutual agreement on data retention and logging (NexGen to confirm)

Attachments included:
- Mutual_Action_Plan_NexGen_v1.pdf (action items, owners, dates)
- NexGen_pilot_scope_diagram.png (visual of data flow and endpoints)

Procurement — I’ve looped you in for visibility; if we pass the exec decision we’ll need a 60-day SOW + PO cadence.

Can everyone confirm the dates above by EOD 2028-06-13 so we can lock resources?

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@nexgenfin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com, procurement@nexgenfin.com
Date: 2028-06-14 16:02 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + owners (draft) — NexGen POC

All good from our side — thanks for the clear plan. Quick confirmations:
- Data: we’ll push the anonymized extract to the shared S3 (pre-signed URLs) by 2028-06-13 20:00 EDT. URL TTL will be 72 hours; if you need longer we’ll extend on request.
- Readout attendees: Lina Park (Head of Ops) — primary decision maker; Marcus Reed (CTO) — optional attendee if metrics meet primary gate.
- Procurement: I’m asking procurement to prepare a standard SOW template; they’ll reach out to Marissa for expected scope and estimate inputs.

Please proceed with onboarding and baseline runs. We expect to treat the week-of-2028-07-10 as the exec decision window; if you can propose two 45-minute slots that week we’ll lock one.

Alex
